why: The Genoese republic's last Madrid minister in the Revolutionary Wars; keys of the series are in the same fonds.

shelfmark: Bologna, Biblioteca Universitaria, Ms. Marsili 75/C, cc. 91r-92r (Manus CNMD record 1846991)

why: One short cipher letter from the Papal Secretary of State in the 1708 Comacchio war with a possible attached decipherment as a crib.

title: Piero Alamanni (Rome) -> Niccolo Michelozzi (Naples): some lines ciphered
correspondents: Piero Alamanni -> Niccolo Michelozzi, Florentine mandatory at Naples
shelfmark: Florence, Biblioteca nazionale centrale, Ginori Conti 29.104 (Manus CNMD record 610402)
folio_note: cc. 5r-6v (BNCF inventory no. 3422591); the earlier letter of 23 Dec 1486 (Milan, cc. 1r-2v) is not marked as cipher
status: Still open (Brice Dudout, 5 Nov 2026): not a Lorenzo letter and no edition found (Lettere and the 1964 Censimento cover Lorenzo's own letters). Only about 55 cipher signs in three short runs on c. 5v, with no interlinear gloss: too short to solve without the key. The 29.114.a key sheets were looked through quickly and none was confirmed. Earlier note: Manus: 'Alcune righe sono cifrate.' No decipherment noted. Not on DECODE. Manus gives the sheet-by-sheet description; the 29.114.a key sheets (Otto di Pratica, Dieci di Balia) are on the same fund and may fit.
why: A Roman news letter of Lorenzo's last months (Innocent VIII, Virginio Orsini), partly ciphered.
